contract: POST /logout. Clear refresh/auth-method cookies, revoke the current session or allDevices=1 sessions, and return redirect_url for configured OIDC logout or null; logged-out credentials must no longer refresh.
exceptions: This record covers one successful web OIDC logout state transition; repeat, error and edge variants remain unverified.
No separate force/refresh mode is defined for this endpoint; any repeat, changed-input or lifecycle refresh remains unverified in the state scenarios.

Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: this requirement has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: POST /logout needs no authentication; with the refresh token (cookie or x-refresh-token) it deletes that sessions row, expires the refresh_token and auth_method cookies and answers 200 {redirect_url:null}; without or with an unknown token it answers the same and deletes nothing. Repeating it is harmless and other sessions stay.
exceptions: Local login/logout connect.sid regeneration is verified by F05 within-side value assertions. OIDC-specific callback/start/logout cookie lifecycle remains unverified because the OIDC differential normalizes connect.sid values.
Logout with no refresh token presented, allDevices=1, logout errors and mobile logout remain separate unverified variants.

Historical representation-level observation superseded by fixed client/persisted contract: Local logout without OIDC: clears refresh_token and auth_method cookies with epoch Expires, REGENERATES the session — every logout responds with a fresh signed connect.sid (Path=/, HttpOnly) replacing the previously presented identifier — responds 200 json {'redirect_url':null} with exact Express JSON headers (21-byte body), deletes the session row for the presented current refresh token (a rotated/stale token leaves a live session), and the access token remains usable afterwards.

invariants.contract: With auth_method openid or openid-mobile and an end-session endpoint configured, logout answers that URL with id_token_hint from the openid_id_token cookie and, for openid only, post_logout_redirect_uri of the server login page; it expires auth_method, openid_id_token and refresh_token cookies and deletes the session.
exceptions: Only a successful web OIDC session with no provider logout endpoint is covered; logout errors, allDevices and mobile logout remain unverified.

Historical representation-level observation superseded by fixed client/persisted contract: In the selected web OIDC session case, POST /logout matches Express response JSON and ETag, clears the three auth cookies with upstream attributes, and deletes the active refresh session while retaining the user. Passport regenerates connect.sid during logout; the existing OIDC differential normalizes its value, so OIDC-specific replacement remains unverified.

invariants.contract: POST /logout?allDevices=1 deletes every sessions row of the user that owns the presented current or just-rotated refresh token and no other user's; any other allDevices value deletes only the presented session.
exceptions: Source-derived obligation and scenario binding only. No live run or independent completeness review was performed in this reconciliation; the full requirement remains open.
